grammar.pattern: 必须 / 一定 / 差不多 / 好像 / 也许
grammar.purpose: Keep obligation, certainty and approximation separate
grammar.explanation: 必须 states a requirement; 一定 expresses a firm expectation or commitment. 差不多 marks approximation, 好像 an impression and 也许 a possibility. A cloudy forecast does not license 一定下雨. Say 也许会下雨 when uncertain. 差不多三度 is approximate, not an exact measurement. Different words change the strength of the claim, not the evidence available.

examples.zh: 必须先看通知，不一定要去室外。
examples.py: bì xū xiān kàn tōng zhī , bù yí dìng yào qù shì wài .
examples.en: We must check the notice first; we do not necessarily have to go outdoors.

examples.zh: 两条路差不多远，好像都能走。
examples.py: liǎng tiáo lù chà bu duō yuǎn , hǎo xiàng dōu néng zǒu .
examples.en: The two routes are about equally far; it looks as though both are usable.

examples.zh: 也许下雨，时间一确认，我一定告诉你。
examples.py: yě xǔ xià yǔ , shí jiān yī què rèn , wǒ yí dìng gào sù nǐ .
examples.en: It may rain; once the time is confirmed, I will definitely tell you.

commonMistakes.why: Clouds alone do not make the forecast certain.

grammar.pattern: 条件：如果 … 就 / … 的话，就 / 不用连词
grammar.purpose: Give a condition and its consequence
grammar.explanation: 如果下雨，我们就在室内见 and 下雨的话，我们就在室内见 make the condition explicit. In a known plan 下雨就换地方 can omit 如果. The consequence only follows when that condition holds; this is not a claim that rain will occur. Keep the subject of each clause clear. State what stays fixed and what changes.

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就在室内见。
examples.py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ , wǒ men jiù zài shì nèi jiàn .
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will meet indoors.

examples.py: xià yǔ de huà , jiù huàn dào fàn guǎn .
examples.en: If it rains, change to the restaurant.

examples.zh: 天晴就在公园见，时间不变。
examples.py: tiān qíng jiù zài gōng yuán jiàn , shí jiān bù biàn .
examples.en: If it is clear, meet at the park; the time stays the same.

commonMistakes.wrong: 如果下雨，所以我们在室内见。
commonMistakes.right: 如果下雨，我们就在室内见。
commonMistakes.why: 如果 sets a condition; 所以 is a causal link and is not the paired condition marker here.

grammar.explanation: 只要有空，就可以来 says having time is enough for this invitation. It does not require bad weather, a gift or a particular season. Contrast 如果下雨，就在室内见: the condition chooses the venue, not whether the person is allowed to come. Do not confuse 只要 with 只有…才, which states a necessary condition and is taught separately later.

examples.py: zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu kōng , jiù kě yǐ lái .
examples.en: As long as you are free, you may come.

examples.zh: 只要场地开着，我们就按计划见。
examples.py: zhǐ yào chǎng dì kāi zhe , wǒ men jiù àn jì huà jiàn .
examples.en: As long as the venue is open, we will meet according to plan.

examples.zh: 只要先发消息，就不用一直等。
examples.py: zhǐ yào xiān fā xiāo xī , jiù bù yòng yì zhí děng .
examples.en: As long as we message first, we need not keep waiting.

commonMistakes.why: The invitation makes free time sufficient; it does not require rain or use 只要…才.

lines.zh: 明天还是七点见吗？
lines.py: míng tiān hái shi qī diǎn jiàn ma ?
lines.en: Are we still meeting at seven tomorrow?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，时间不变。如果天晴，我们就在公园见。
lines.py: duì , shí jiān bù biàn . rú guǒ tiān qíng , wǒ men jiù zài gōng yuán jiàn .
lines.en: Yes, the time stays the same. If it is clear, we will meet in the park.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 预报说多云，一定下雨吗？
lines.py: yù bào shuō duō yún , yí dìng xià yǔ ma ?
lines.en: The forecast says cloudy. Is rain certain?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不一定。好像会下雨，但现在只能说也许。
lines.py: bù yí dìng . hǎo xiàng huì xià yǔ , dàn xiàn zài zhǐ néng shuō yě xǔ .
lines.en: Not necessarily. It looks like rain, but for now we can only say maybe.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 下雨的话，就不见了吗？
lines.py: xià yǔ de huà , jiù bú jiàn le ma ?
lines.en: If it rains, will we not meet?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，下雨就换到饭馆，还是七点。
lines.py: bù shì , xià yǔ jiù huàn dào fàn guǎn , hái shi qī diǎn .
lines.en: No, if it rains we change to the restaurant, still at seven.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我住得远，必须去吗？
lines.py: wǒ zhù dé yuǎn , bì xū qù ma ?
lines.en: I live far away. Must I go?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用。只要你有空，就可以来；不方便也可以改天。
lines.py: bù yòng . zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu kōng , jiù kě yǐ lái ; bù fāng biàn yě kě yǐ gǎi tiān .
lines.en: No. As long as you are free, you can come; if inconvenient, another day is fine.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 气温可能到零下三度，路上有雪怎么办？
lines.py: qì wēn kě néng dào líng xià sān dù , lù shàng yǒu xuě zěn me bàn ?
lines.en: The temperature may reach minus three. What if there is snow on the road?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那就先问场地有没有开，别急着出门。
lines.py: nà jiù xiān wèn chǎng dì yǒu méi yǒu kāi , bié jí zhe chū mén .
lines.en: Then first ask whether the venue is open; do not rush out.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我明天下午再看通知。
lines.py: wǒ míng tiān xià wǔ zài kàn tōng zhī .
lines.en: I will check the notice tomorrow afternoon.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，地方一确认，我一定发消息。
lines.py: hǎo , dì fāng yī què rèn , wǒ yí dìng fā xiāo xī .
lines.en: Good. Once the place is confirmed, I will definitely message.
lines.speaker: b
